query: How do I pair a Bluetooth device with my iPhone?
reference_answer: Before you can use a Bluetooth device with iPhone you must first pair them. Make the device discoverable, then on iPhone go to Settings > Bluetooth and turn Bluetooth on. Select the device and enter its passkey or PIN if asked. See the documentation that came with the device for how to make it discoverable and for its passkey.

query: How do I print from my iPhone using AirPrint?
reference_answer: AirPrint lets you print wirelessly to AirPrint-enabled printers from iOS apps such as Mail, Photos, Camera, Safari, iBooks, Maps and Notes. iPhone and the printer must be on the same Wi-Fi network. To print, tap the share or action control in the app and choose Print, then select a printer and print options.

query: How do I restart my iPhone?
reference_answer: Hold down the Sleep/Wake button until the red slider appears, then slide your finger across the slider to turn iPhone off. To turn it back on, hold down the Sleep/Wake button until the Apple logo appears.

query: What is Personal Hotspot and what do I need to use it?
reference_answer: Personal Hotspot (iPhone 4 or later) lets you share your iPhone's Internet connection with a computer or another device over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or USB. It works only when iPhone is connected to the Internet over the cellular data network. The feature may not be available in all areas and additional fees may apply.

query: How do I back up my iPhone with iCloud, and can I also back it up with iTunes?
reference_answer: You can use iCloud or iTunes to automatically back up iPhone. iCloud backs up daily over Wi-Fi when iPhone is connected to power and locked; the date and time of the last backup appear at the bottom of the Storage & Backup screen. If you choose iCloud for automatic backups you cannot also use iTunes to back up automatically, but you can still use iTunes to back up to your computer manually.

query: What security features does iPhone have, and how does setting a passcode protect my data?
reference_answer: Security features help protect the information on iPhone from being accessed by others. You can set a passcode that must be entered each time you turn on or wake iPhone, or when you access the passcode lock settings. Setting a passcode also turns on data protection, which uses your passcode as the key for encrypting mail messages and attachments stored on iPhone. Some apps from the App Store may also use data protection.

query: What is the difference between restarting and resetting my iPhone, and how do I force an app to close?
reference_answer: If something isn't working right, try restarting iPhone, forcing an app to close, or resetting iPhone. To restart, hold the Sleep/Wake button until the red slider appears, slide to power off, then hold Sleep/Wake again until the Apple logo appears. To force an app to close, hold the Sleep/Wake button for a few seconds until a red slider appears, then hold the Home button until the app closes. Resetting is the more disruptive step and should be tried after restarting.

query: What can Siri do on my iPhone?
reference_answer: Siri is the intelligent personal assistant that lets you get things done by talking. Siri can understand natural speech, so you don't have to learn specific commands or keywords. You can ask Siri to send messages, schedule meetings, place phone calls, get directions, set reminders, search the web and more, and Siri asks follow-up questions when it needs clarification.
